name: Dustline Seal
description: Closes cracks, bars minor intrusion, and keeps out vermin, drafts, ash, and casual tampering from a camp or chamber.

name: Alarm Sigil
description: Attunes a point, object, or boundary to warn the caster when crossed, touched, or disturbed.

name: Guard Charm
description: Places a brief protective force on a creature or object that blunts one strike, fall, or magical surge.

name: Traveler's Veil
description: Shields a target from cold, heat, rain, sparks, and mild environmental strain.

name: Anchor Charm
description: Stabilizes body and mind against knockback, fear, compulsion, magical disorientation, and forced movement.

name: Threshold Lock
description: Mystically seals a door, gate, chest, or portal against opening, tampering, and unauthorized entry.

name: Deflecting Plane
description: Raises a directional barrier that turns aside arrows, stones, debris, and lesser projectiles.

name: Hexbreak
description: Weakens or unravels one active curse, hostile enchantment, tether, or magical mark.

name: Shelter Sphere
description: Creates a compact warded refuge against weather, smoke, debris, and incidental hostile magic.

name: Null Mantle
description: Wraps a target in disciplined ward-force that dampens poison, magic, draining effects, and concentrated harm.

name: Spell Reversal
description: Interrupts, frays, redirects, or partially reflects an incoming spell if caught at the right moment.

name: Bastion Line
description: Raises a standing barrier of structured force that enemies struggle to cross and allies can safely fight behind.

name: Fortress Weave
description: Interlocks wards across a structure or camp so walls, gates, and watchpoints resist intrusion, scrying, sorcery, and siege strain.

name: Dome of Refusal
description: Erects a broad hemispheric barrier that repels storms, volleys, summoned entry, and lesser spells while isolating those within.

name: Citadel Absolute
description: The supreme ward: for a brief span, a chosen site, host, or cause becomes extraordinarily difficult to breach, corrupt, overturn, or meaningfully damage.
